name: agency-agents
description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
one_liner: A big library of ready-made AI assistant 'personalities', like a virtual frontend developer or virtual marketer, that you install into tools like Claude Code so you get a specialist instead of one generic assistant.
buyer: A solo founder or small dev team who wants the experience of having specialist 'team members', such as a security reviewer or a marketer, without actually hiring any of them.
business_use_cases: A solo founder installs the marketing and frontend agent packs to get specialist help without hiring contractors.
A dev agency standardizes which agent personas its engineers use so AI-assisted output is more consistent across projects.
A tooling company builds a paid marketplace layer on top where teams can buy curated, verified high-quality agent packs beyond the free roster.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a curated premium agent pack, vetted and tested for specific niches like e-commerce or fintech teams, on top of the free open roster.
Offer a one-time 'agent setup and customization' consulting package for teams who want personas tailored to their actual codebase and style guide.

steal_this: This weekend, pick the 3 most-used agent personas, write a tight onboarding guide, and offer a paid 'done for you' install and customization service for small teams.
